title: rhodanthe maryonii
intro: Rhodanthe maryonii, commonly known as Mary's Pink or Billy Button, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to the southwestern region of Australia. The health benefits of Rhodanthe maryonii include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Rhodanthe maryonii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
